item.description: Breaking: Sources in Baghdad tell the Iraqi outlet Al-Mada that Prime Minister al-Zaidi is awaiting authorization from Iraq's ruling coalition to arrest members of the Iran-aligned armed factions in the country. The coalition has warned him this could cause governmental collapse
